title: fix: add agent request bodies to generated API docs
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds runnable request bodies for agent creation and updates
- Fixes `docs:validate` failures for `/account/agents`
- Keeps `APIDOCS.md` generated and untouched

Follow-up to #13609.

gist.headline: Agents get their forms
gist.blurb: The agent docs now bring the actual paperwork. Creation and update examples come with runnable request bodies, as nature intended.
gist.summary: Updated the API documentation generator to include runnable request bodies for creating and updating agents at `/account/agents`, while keeping `APIDOCS.md` generated from source.
gist.impact: Developers can now copy complete payload examples for agent creation and updates instead of assembling request bodies from context.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful API gardener, placing neatly labeled request-body seed packets into two pots marked CREATE and UPDATE beside a cozy terminal showing `/account/agents`. Small code-plants and documentation pages make the newly complete examples feel immediately usable.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush and light blue wings, wearing tiny librarian glasses as she files two glowing API request-body papers into flower pots labeled CREATE and UPDATE beside a retro terminal showing `/account/agents`; runnable code-plants sprout from the pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel cream-lavender gradient background, warm lighting, subtle CRT glow, pixel-font text: "REQUEST BODY", retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
